topic.topic: Why Pluto lost its planet status
topic.angle: The 2006 IAU decision and the three criteria for a planet

panels.text: Pluto kept its status as a planet until 2006.
The discovery of other large objects in the Kuiper belt, particularly Eris, sparked a debate about what a planet really is.
In August 2006 the International Astronomical Union set three criteria: a planet orbits the Sun, is massive enough to be nearly round, and has cleared the neighbourhood around its orbit.
Pluto meets the first two but not the third. So it became a dwarf planet.

probes.question: Which planet criterion does Pluto not meet?
options: It has cleared the neighbourhood around its orbit
